tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.description: Get the latest regular-market quote for a single ticker symbol.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Get historical OHLCV candles for a ticker over a period (e.g. '5d', '1mo', '1y').

tools.name: get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Get the quarterly balance sheet for a ticker, including ordinary shares outstanding per quarter end.

tools.name: get_major_holders
tools.description: Get the major-holders breakdown for a ticker: insiders held %, institutions held %, and number of institutions.

tools.name: get_institutional_holders
tools.description: Get the top institutional holders for a ticker: holder name, shares held, holding value, holding ratio, and quarter-over-quarter percentage change.
